# 🔄 Migration Guide (Existing Devs)

This page walks long‑time Pedalogical contributors through the key changes needed to align with our **current tech stack**.

---

## 1 · Move Secrets to `.env`

We no longer store connection strings or API keys in `appsettings.json`.

```bash
cp .env.example .env
code .env
```

> Populate `POSTGRES_PASSWORD`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, and any other keys shown in the template.

*See full instructions →* [Environment Variables](env-vars.qmd)

---

## 2 · Switch from SQL Server → PostgreSQL 17

Local development now uses PostgreSQL.  
Follow either the native install or Docker‑Compose option.

*See full instructions →* [Database Setup](database.qmd)

> After switching engines, apply EF Core migrations before running the app.

---

## 3 · Smoke‑Test the Application

Run the app end‑to‑end to confirm the migration was successful.

*Guide →* [Run the App](run-app.qmd)

Checklist:

1. `dotnet build` succeeds.  
2. EF Core migrations apply without errors `dotnet ef database update`.  
3. App starts at `https://localhost:5000` or whatever port is configured.  
4. Front‑end fetches sample data without 500s.
